paragraph1: All Frames was born in 2022, when João Gabriel started the project on Instagram, combining his passion for technology and gaming.
paragraph2: In September 2024, with Raí joining the partnership, we opened our first physical store. Then in August 2025, with Luiz coming on board, we reshaped the operation and moved fully into the gaming market.
paragraph3: Today we're three partners: João Gabriel, Raí and Luiz Fernando. Each one runs a part of the business: sales, marketing, finance, technical support, PC builds and management. We're based in downtown Bento Gonçalves, in Rio Grande do Sul, and we're also building our e-commerce to reach customers in other regions. All of it, of course, gamer to gamer.
